subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

Experiences that are very unpleasant or difficult
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2 i.e. (Ordeal)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'Experiences that are very unpleasant or difficult' can be replaced by the word "Ordeal". 
 
• "Ordeal" refers to a painful or horrific experience. (कठिन परीक्षा"/"कठिनाई")

Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Ordeal'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Pitfall" (जोखिम) refers to a hidden or unsuspected danger or difficulty.
 
• "Strident" (कठोर) means loud and harsh.
 
• "Knack" (दक्षता) refers to an acquired or natural skill at doing something.
